project_description: REST API service on the vladdoster platform.

__prompts__.project_slug: Service name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; max 40 chars; becomes the repo and service.yaml name)
__prompts__.github_org: GitHub org hosting platform-infra and this service
__prompts__.path_prefix: Ingress path prefix (starts with /, no trailing /)
__prompts__.cpu: Fargate task CPU units (quoted string in service.yaml)
__prompts__.memory: Fargate task memory in MiB (quoted string in service.yaml)
__prompts__.database: Database: none, shared cluster, or dedicated instance
__prompts__.deploy_environments: Deploy pipeline: dev only, or dev -> staging -> prod promotion
